name: aquavoice
description: Read-only answers about your AquaVoice call-center office: leads, calls, follow-ups, campaigns and your team's hours and results.

interface.longDescription:
AquaVoice is a call-center and outbound sales CRM for sales offices: leads, a power dialer, calls with AI summaries, follow-ups, campaigns and team attendance. This plugin lets an office manager ask about their own office in plain words, and get answers built from the office's live data.

Examples of what a manager can ask:
- How did the office do this week, and how does it compare to last week?
- Why was this lead not dialed today?
- Which rep had the most meetings booked this month?
- How many hours did a rep work yesterday, and how much of it was idle time?
- What follow-ups are overdue, and who owns them?
- What happened on a specific call, according to its AI summary?

The plugin is read-only. No tool creates, changes, deletes or dials anything: changes are made in the AquaVoice app itself.

Each connection reaches one office only, the office of the manager who signed in, and only an active office manager can connect. Phone numbers are shown by their last 4 digits only (or not at all, if the office hides them), other long numbers and email addresses are removed, and no tool returns call transcripts, recordings, CRM fields or wages.

The office manager switches the connection on in AquaVoice (Settings > Integrations > AI connection), can see every tool call in a log, and can disconnect any connection at any time. An idle connection closes by itself after 90 days.

Requires an AquaVoice office manager account.
capabilities: Lead history and why the dialer did or did not call a lead
Call search and AI call summaries
defaultPrompt: How did my office do this week compared to last week?
Which follow-ups are overdue, and who owns them?
Who on my team booked the most meetings this month?

positive.description: Office performance for a period. The test office is AquaVoice's own internal sales office, with about 40 calls this month.
positive.prompt: How did my office do this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns this month's calls, answer rate, meetings and results for the office, says which period the numbers cover, and uses English labels. No number is invented.
Lists the office's team members with their roles. Names may be in Hebrew; labels are in English.

positive.description: Find recent calls and read one call's AI summary.
positive.prompt: Show me the latest calls and summarize one of them.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent calls (time, agent, result, duration), then gives the AI summary of one call. Phone numbers appear by their last 4 digits only; no transcript or recording is returned.

positive.description: Explain why the power dialer is or is not calling a lead.
positive.prompt: Show me the latest leads, and explain why one of them is or is not being dialed right now.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the office's leads with their status, then names the dialer rule that holds or allows one lead (dials per lead, hours between dials, daily ceiling, do-not-call or the campaign's selection), marking each fact as known, estimated or unknown.

positive.description: Campaigns and whether their dialer is on.
positive.prompt: Tell me about my campaigns. Is the dialer running on any of them?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the office's campaigns with their status, and for a campaign says whether its dialer is on and, if not, why. It keeps the campaign status and the dialer state apart.

negative.description: A write request. The plugin is read-only and has no tool that changes data, so it should say it can only read and name the screen in the AquaVoice app where this is done (the lead card).
negative.prompt: Change the status of my latest lead to Won.

negative.description: A full phone number. Tools return only the last 4 digits of a phone number, so the answer should say so and point to the lead card in the app, without guessing or composing a number.
negative.prompt: Give me the full phone number of my latest lead so I can call them.

negative.description: Data the plugin does not have. There are no recordings and no transcripts, so the answer should say they are not available here (the AI summary and the call's details are) and point to the call in the AquaVoice app, instead of inventing a transcript.
negative.prompt: Play me the recording of my latest call and show me its full transcript.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments. It only reads data from the signed-in manager's own AquaVoice office.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 14 read-only tools for office managers (office overview, leads, dialer explanation, team, hours, performance, calls, follow-ups and campaigns).

he-IL.subtitle: שאלו על המוקד שלכם
he-IL.description:
AquaVoice היא מערכת CRM למוקדי מכירות ושירות: לידים, חייגן אוטומטי, שיחות עם סיכום AI, מעקבים, קמפיינים ונוכחות צוות. התוסף מאפשר למנהל משרד לשאול על המשרד שלו במילים פשוטות ולקבל תשובות מהנתונים החיים של המשרד.

התוסף קורא בלבד: אף כלי לא יוצר, משנה, מוחק או מחייג. כל חיבור רואה משרד אחד בלבד, של המנהל שנכנס. מספרי טלפון מוצגים לפי 4 הספרות האחרונות בלבד, ואין הקלטות, תמלולים או שכר.

המנהל מפעיל את החיבור ב-AquaVoice (הגדרות > אינטגרציות > חיבור AI), רואה יומן של כל קריאה, ויכול לנתק בכל רגע. נדרש חשבון מנהל משרד ב-AquaVoice.
